title: Goldring 2100 — Micro Seiki DQX-500 — 1 kHz Reference Check

harmonic_reliability.quality_note: The right channel's third harmonic changed most during recording. Repeat before changing the cartridge setup.

interpretation.summary: The DQX-500 capture averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%) with 0.032% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Average 1 kHz separation was 20.1 dB and channel balance was −0.54 dB. The right-channel third harmonic changed most during recording, so the report advises repeating the capture before adjusting the cartridge setup.
interpretation.recommendation: Repeat before changing cartridge setup, as the report advises. Document the remaining tonearm, test-record and capture settings to support comparison.

provenance.data_entry_method: Values transcribed verbatim from the original PDF report; rounded differences are preserved rather than recalculated.
provenance.raw_audio_note: No raw test-record audio is included.
provenance.setup_metadata_source: The PDF does not name the turntable or cartridge and leaves the input field blank. The measurer identified the playback chain in conversation as Micro Seiki DQX-500, Goldring 2100, Audio Research SP20 and EVO4. The illustrative hero was based on a previously supplied photograph of this turntable and cartridge.
known_limitations: The PDF has a blank input field and does not identify the turntable or cartridge. Micro Seiki DQX-500, Goldring 2100, Audio Research SP20 and EVO4 were subsequently confirmed by the measurer.
The hero photograph predates this capture and is illustrative rather than capture-specific evidence.
Tonearm, stylus, loading, tracking force, alignment, anti-skate, test-record identity and track, capture settings, software versions, timezone and repeat count were not supplied.
The right-channel third harmonic varied during this recording; repeat before changing cartridge setup, as the source report states.
Reported differences retain source precision and may differ from subtraction of rounded channel values.
provenance.fingerprint_channel_assignment: L/R labels follow the order of the two screenshots supplied for each metric; the screenshots themselves do not display channel labels.
provenance.photo_treatment: The previously retouched DQX-500 and Goldring 2100 hero is reused as an illustrative equipment image. Original HEIC preserved. Fingerprint source PNGs are unedited; WebP copies are format conversions for web display.
